implementation: Update SKILL.md and role/state guidance with an explicit closeout stage after all applicable work-unit requirements and mandatory verification have independently passed, before the separate final checker and publication. A Done marker on an unmerged branch describes verified proposed branch state and must explicitly avoid claiming master has landed. Final acceptance still covers the entire committed candidate including bookkeeping.

Add the minimum helper state/actions/guards needed to make closeout concrete and recoverable. Persist closeout intent before editing and record its completed source candidate only after committed canonical backlog edits actually exist. Track exact candidate/base/plan, required root/unit keys and canonical locations, concise passing evidence and an honest branch/compare reference. Missing, unfinished, stale or invalidated closeout cannot permit final acceptance/publication/completion. Keep old reports and evidence append-only, source editing with the coordinator/implementer rather than silently rewriting source from state.

Use a bounded two-pass lifecycle: accepted implementation -> durable closeout intent -> bookkeeping commit -> recorded prepared closeout candidate -> renewed applicable unit checks at that candidate -> separate final checker -> one publication. Bookkeeping changes invalidate prior exact-commit approvals. Prepared closeout survives successful renewal so another bookkeeping edit is not requested after each successful checker. Reuse existing evidence only as provenance; never relabel old unit acceptance as acceptance of the new SHA. A renewal path may dispatch checker-only unit checks where no implementation work changed; avoid consuming repair rounds just for metadata or looping through closeout again. Action names/layout are implementer choices if these invariants hold.

On checker rejection or source/base/plan change, invalidate affected closeout claims together with existing approvals. Persist an explicit required removal/reconciliation obligation and next action. Before any repair candidate can be accepted or published, restore affected canonical Done markers to an honest incomplete status in source and record that fact; root loses Done whenever a required child/criterion is open. Preserve independently completed unaffected children only with applicable evidence. An interruption between invalidation and source cleanup remains visibly unfinished and cannot publish. Re-establish Done only after fresh applicable checks, then renew exact-candidate checks once.

Future split units must have canonical definitions/statuses in tracked source documentation carried by the implementation PR. Update the current artifact-only canonical-subtask guidance where necessary; do not maintain two canonical definitions. Legacy artifact-only units require explicit location migration with permanent keys/titles/original criteria/dependencies preserved before closeout. This run remains unsplit, so allocate no keys and change no registry allocation state.

Use a stable GitHub branch or compare reference such as https://github.com/robinwassen/Fossilize/compare/master...codex/FOS-000026-backlog-completion in FOS-000026 bookkeeping; say it is the proposed implementation branch/compare, not an already existing PR. Avoid embedding the self-referential final SHA in its own commit. A later actual PR URL belongs in publication state/PR description; no post-review source edit is needed solely to replace the stable reference.

Reconcile FOS-000025 only using actual merged PR #2 and retained checker-final/run evidence. Update its stale canonical status and the misleading document-level v1-candidate status consistently, preserving its requirement paragraph. Summarize historical 27-test independent verification and metadata validation at e01fa9d68ade5384f214ec46a6ddc352b22a03de, linked actual PR #2; do not imply those historical executions verify new changes.

Self-apply this flow in the current run. Preserve already recorded schema-2 initialization/planner/worker facts and immutable original acceptance. Make new closeout fields backward compatible for the current old-helper state or provide an explicit minimal normalization with provenance; absent fields mean pending closeout, never fabricated completion. After the first independently accepted implementation candidate, coordinator adopts the new implementation helper, records closeout, commits FOS-000026 Done with concise actual evidence, renews required exact-candidate checks, and obtains separate final acceptance. Continue the same run and one-PR identity; preserve the old completed FOS-000025 record.
